rules.requirement: Evidence-based appraisal including reuse, no-build and alternatives where feasible; project authority approves direction S1 then master plan S2 at exact revision. Proportionate B0-B2 compact/B3-B5 structured; routine approved tasks do not reopen S1/S2.

Reuse six functional groups and existing twelve department responsibilities. One canonical WorkPackage, provider-neutral capability routing, single writer per mutation scope, independent verification, authenticated bounded dispatch.

Event-driven deterministic monitoring; coalesce root causes; accumulated burden >30 triggers immediate scoped remediation; danger >40 or critical/mandatory gate failure requires verified root-cause closure; no repeated unchanged action, no arbitrary retries.

Minimum context, WIP and resource budgets, critical path, selective QA evidence reuse with dependency/environment/revision validity, exact mandatory gates unchanged. Measure accepted outcomes, tokens if available, rework and elapsed time. Unknown is not zero.

Federated engines retain data and independent evaluation. App Manager uses existing management entry; graph derives from canonical state, authenticates all commands at Hub, separates risk/progress/health/authority and marks stale/unknown. No shadow registry, no physical rename without reviewed migration.

Independent specialist learning with provenance and holdout evaluation; no weight-training claim without evidence. Policy-first; verify one real vertical slice before broader rollout; no UI prerequisite for lawful publication.
